mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between UNRATE and 20-day forward returns is not positive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 150,000) combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255) indicates an overheating economy that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal from the interaction (PAYEMS>150000 and CPIAUCSL>255) fails to materialize in more than 40% of instances (i.e., SPX returns are positive in >40% of triggered cases) or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) signals deteriorating economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 109.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market strength (HOUST > 1350) indicates robust consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1350 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST > 1350) combined with robust retail sales (RSAFS > 525,000) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return signal from the interaction (HOUST>1350 and RSAFS>525000) fails to materialize in more than 40% of instances (i.e., SPX returns are negative in >40% of triggered cases) or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO > 110.0) indicates strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 110.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS and 20-day forward returns is not positive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
